en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing a quiet, cobblestoned town with two‑storey plaster houses with steep tiled roofs. On the right corner stands a shop with a sign reading "Colonialwaaren, Destillation." and large initials "F.M.N." A few adults and children stand near the buildings. Tele­phone or telegraph poles line the street, and there is handwritten numbering on the image border, indicating it was used as a photographic postcard or archival image.
